description: Reads a NeuroVue window's recent console output and WebGPU errors (uncaptured validation errors and device loss), newest last, from a buffer of the last 500 entries.

levels.description: Only these levels: log, info, warn, error, or gpu (WebGPU errors). All otherwise.

since.description: Only entries at or after this time, in milliseconds since the epoch; a previous answer's now reads only what came after it.

limit.description: At most this many entries, the newest. 100 otherwise.

entries.description: Each entry's time (ms since the epoch), level and text.

dropped.description: Entries pushed out of the buffer since it was last cleared.

now.description: The page's time when it answered, for the next call's since.

neuroflow/mcp.name: console_log
neuroflow/mcp.title: Read a NeuroVue window's console and WebGPU errors

useWhen: A render goes blank or wrong and you want the WebGPU validation errors behind it.
Check what a change logged: take now from one call, make the change, then read with since.
